en.intro3Vo: Match the correct circle parts, stop the zombies, and protect the safe zone!
en.ruleMinorArc: Minor arc: just a curved edge, less than half the circle.
en.ruleMajorArc: Major arc: just a curved edge, more than half the circle.
en.ruleMinorSector: Minor sector: two radii and a small arc.
en.ruleMajorSector: Major sector: two radii and a big arc.
en.ruleMinorSegment: Minor segment: a chord and a small arc.
en.ruleMajorSegment: Major segment: a chord and a big arc.
en.reasonMinorArc: It is only the curved edge, with no straight sides, so it is an arc. It is less than half the circle, so it is minor.
en.reasonMajorArc: It is only the curved edge, with no straight sides, so it is an arc. It is more than half the circle, so it is major.
en.reasonMinorSector: It touches the centre with two straight edges, so it is a sector. It is smaller than half, so it is minor.
en.reasonMajorSector: It touches the centre with two straight edges, so it is a sector. It is bigger than half, so it is major.
en.reasonMinorSegment: It has one straight edge, a chord, and stays away from the centre, so it is a segment. It is smaller than half, so it is minor.
en.reasonMajorSegment: It has one straight edge, a chord, and covers the centre, so it is a segment. It is bigger than half, so it is major.
en.wallSubCalm: One question: match the window to knock the zombie out. No timer!
en.wallSubTimer: One question: match the window before the zombie climbs in — {s} seconds!
en.endSub: You matched the circle parts and protected the safe zone!
en.goSub: Don't worry — let's look at the last piece together.
en.rotateDevice: Please rotate your device to landscape ↻
